Subject: not sure if this is even the right email but here goes

Hi HR team, I hope this finds you well, sorry in advance for the length of this, I've been drafting and re-drafting it for like a week because I wasn't even sure I should send it, but a friend in a totally different department convinced me it's better to say something than sit on it, so here goes nothing.

So I've been at Northfield Logistics for about two and a half years now, started as a coordinator and got promoted to senior coordinator last spring, which I was really excited about at the time. The team itself is honestly great, I want to say that upfront because I don't want this to come across as me trashing everyone I work with, most of the people on my team are wonderful and I'd hate for this email to somehow make things awkward with them.

The actual thing I wanted to mention, and I keep going back and forth on whether to even call it a 'complaint' because that word feels so heavy, is about how project assignments have been handled the last few months. Since March, there have been four new high-visibility client accounts that came in, and all four went to Jordan, who joined the team about 4 months after me. I don't want to make this about Jordan personally at all, they're good at their job and I don't think this is their doing in any way, this is more about how my manager, Priyanka, has been assigning things. I've asked twice, once in a 1:1 in April and once in another 1:1 in June, whether there were opportunities for me to take on a bigger account, and both times Priyanka said something like 'let's revisit that next quarter' without much more detail than that.

I want to be really clear that I am NOT accusing Priyanka of anything discriminatory or anything like that, I don't have any reason to think that's what's happening, it might genuinely just be about who happened to be available or who had bandwidth when those accounts came in, I really don't know the full picture from where I sit. I'm also not asking for any kind of investigation or formal process here, and I definitely don't want Priyanka to get in any kind of trouble over this email, that's really not my intent at all.

What I guess I am hoping for, if I'm being honest with myself about why I'm even writing this, is maybe just some general guidance on how account assignments typically get decided around here, since it's never been totally clear to me, and maybe some feedback on what I could be doing differently if there's something on my end that's holding me back from being considered for bigger accounts. If there's a skills gap or something I should be working on, I'd genuinely rather know now than keep guessing.

Oh, and completely separately, I wanted to mention that the parking garage validation stickers ran out again last month, that's like the third time this year, could someone look into ordering more in bulk so we don't keep running out? Totally unrelated to the other thing, just figured since I was already writing an email to HR I'd mention it.

Anyway, thank you for reading this whole thing, I know it was long and probably could have been way shorter, but I wanted to give full context. Happy to talk more if that's helpful, but also totally fine if the answer is just some general info about how assignments work. Thanks so much.

Best,
Taylor Bloom
